verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs say you can connect an individual work inbox to send one-to-one emails from the CRM and log email replies to the CRM. That covers the core of connecting an inbox and logging email. The evidence never names Gmail or Outlook, never describes true two-way sync, and never explains how logged emails are matched to the correct contact, company or deal records. Missing for 10: explicit Gmail/Outlook provider support, documented two-way sync behavior, automatic association of emails to the correct records, independent or hands-on corroboration.
